how: B-9dd0 (主开发 r1246): the rows whose node children the egress reader MAY carry into — every ci.mjs row the tree's impact scope (affectedSuites over the READERS) does NOT name. A row not listed (a new suite included) reads its children not at all. Derived; scripts/test-egress-census.mjs re-derives it and is red when it drifts. Each row added after the first derivation is listed in `judged` with its judgement (主开发 r2063): whether the suite starts a child, of what kind, and so how the reader holds it. A program under data/bin that reads a command line (data/bin/job-wrapper.js since line 762, B-d8f4) is driven, by the impact scope's own rule («a program the product spawns keeps every boot»), by EVERY row that boots the product: so no booting row carries. Kept on purpose (主开发 r3733, lg-leak-census): the census is never narrower than the gate's own scope, and the wide rule errs only toward carrying less. test-channel-api-cards left the list at the early hosted run of 2.369.419 (主开发 r4214): 6666caa1c (r3059, MG1) gave it two dynamic imports, ./scratch.mjs (the scratch harness) and ./mutant-copy.mjs (the mutant copy helper), which bring the product's boot into its closure, so it is now a row that boots the product and the impact scope names it as driving a reader (115 -> 114 carried). test-viewport-class left the list at the first hosted pass of .420 (主开发 r4476): 421eb6140 (B-78db line 914's cure) gave its ⑤c a stand-in document whose last node is the page's script, the literal /bundle.js, and the impact scope's boot rule reads that name as a boot (the suite starts no child and boots nothing; the wide rule errs toward carrying less, kept on purpose above), so it is a row that boots the product and the impact scope names it as driving a reader (114 -> 113 carried).
